evals.name: last-tests-for-branch
evals.prompt: retrieve the last tests for the branch master-mail-call-action-list-js-tref-nby
evals.expected_output: Finds the latest batch for the branch, identifies the failing build slot (Enterprise Tests), and reports the failing test(s) with the reproduce command and a root-cause line. Uses the runbot-next CLI (batches --search, build-names, tests --batch --slot).

evals.name: why-is-build-red
evals.prompt: The Enterprise Tests build is red on master-mail-call-action-list-js-tref-nby. Why? Give me the command to reproduce the failing test locally.
evals.expected_output: Locates the branch's latest batch and Enterprise Tests slot, pulls the parsed failure, and surfaces the `command` field (the ./odoo-bin --test-tags reproduce command) plus a short root cause.

evals.name: passing-branch-no-failures
evals.prompt: Did the last batch for branch master-mail-call-action-list-js-tref-nby pass? Summarize the test results.
evals.expected_output: Checks batch status and slot statuses via the CLI and reports clearly whether tests passed or which slots failed, without inventing failures.
